 ATP Basel Day 3 Predictions Including Taylor Fritz vs Rinky Hijikata 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 Day 3 at the ATP 500 event in Basel will feature a lot of exciting matches and high quality tennis. Aside from Novak Djokovic starting his quest for a 103rd title, we will also have several players desperate for points as they aim for a spot in Turin, as well as many looking to have a strong end to the season and gain some momentum ahead of 2027.
 ATP Basel Day 3 Predictions
 Nuno Borges vs Casper Ruud
 Head-to-head: Ruud 2-1 Borges
 Ruud struggled a lot in the first round here, but eventually managed to make it through in a tough three-setter. Borges had a much easier time and if there is a surface where he has an excellent chance in this match it’s on a fast indoor hard court (even if he did beat Ruud at the French Open in 2025). It should be quite a close match, decided by execution in the biggest points.
 Prediction: Borges in 3
 Remy Bertola vs Denis Shapovalov
 Head-to-head: first meeting
 While this match might look one-sided on paper, Shapovalov has been injured lately and even when he is fit his level on any given day is very hard to predict. If he can play at a high level he should be able to win, but he is also prone to puzzling defeats so his matches tend to be quite hard to predict. Bertola is playing at home, played well in qualifying and can certainly have a chance here.
 Prediction: Shapovalov in 3
 Mar 22, 2025; Miami, FL, USA; Denis Shapovalov (CAN) hits a backhand against Thiago Agustin Tirante (ARG)(not pictured) on day five of the Miami Open at Hard Rock Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Geoff Burke-Imagn Images 
 Taylor Fritz vs Rinky Hijikata
 Head-to-head: Fritz 1-0 Hijikata
 Fritz’s final loss to Lorenzo Musetti in Lyon was a blow to his Turin hopes , which will realistically only stay alive if he wins the title this week (or at least reaches the final). That said, on a surface like this his game should be very effective so such a run is definitely possible. His powerful serve and strokes should be enough to overwhelm Hijikata here.
 Prediction: Fritz in 2
